name: Kimray Manufacturing Services
old_description: Our products are engineered, sourced, manufactured, and supported by our expert teams to make sure they work for you.
about:
Kimray Manufacturing Services, operating as Kimray, Inc., is headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company designs and manufactures a broad line of oil and gas control equipment, including valves, regulators, controllers, pumps, actuators, and related accessories. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but the business emphasizes its American-made production and a culture known as the Kimray Way.

Kimray’s operations span engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, and post-sale support, all performed in-house. The company maintains ten company-owned stores across the United States and a network of authorized distributors worldwide, shipping products directly from those locations. Beyond hardware, Kimray provides store services, field maintenance, project consultations, and product training—both hands-on and self-paced online. A dedicated platform, Kimray Electrix™, bundles electric actuation, emissions-reduction tools, and expertise to help operators lower methane output and improve site control.

The primary customers are oil and gas producers, from large international energy companies to independent operators. The company states that “top energy producers in the world use Kimray” and its equipment is found on well sites, production vessels, and gas-processing facilities. Applications include liquid dumping, pressure regulation, level control, glycol pumping, and emissions compliance.

Kimray differentiates itself through the Kimray Way—a stated belief in people, a mission to make a difference, unwavering values, and a promise to customers. The company says it does not simply run machines, assemble parts, or ship products; rather, its team works toward common goals to ensure customers get the most out of each product. This philosophy, combined with a Made-in-USA commitment, underpins its positioning as a premium partner.
